title: Canonical Owner Authority Contract
description: The trust anchor for canonical owner decisions (spec MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 v0.2.0, slice S8, spec sections 12.3/13.1/13.4). It holds the public keys that may sign a canonical owner approval. An approval is only an approval when one of these keys vouches for it: a self-declared approver name and a free decision reference are caller input and authorise nothing. The anchor is a governed repository surface - publishing, rotating or revoking a key is a reviewed change of the canonical tree, never a runtime act. The anchor grants no capability, no permission and no execution authorisation.

authority_id.description: The single authority identity whose approvals this anchor can verify.

authority_status.description: PENDING_PUBLICATION means no key is published yet: every approval is refused fail-closed until the owner publishes one.

public_key_pem.description: SPKI PEM public key. The private key never lives in this repository.
